facts.fact: BusinessDay reports the CBN's June 2026 circular requires payment transaction data generated in Nigeria to be stored and managed in Nigeria from 1 January 2027, covering banks, payment service providers, switches, mobile money operators and other licensed participants.
facts.system: CBN circular on market structure, data localisation, UBO disclosure and systemic oversight in the Nigeria payments system
